entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed.
Support! Get me a person now!
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Sarah, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's an absolute piece of junk and I'm not paying for it.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Could I start with your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's Mark Peterson. The email is mark.p@email.com. Just process the return, I don't have time for a runaround.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see you're one of our VIP members. Thank you for your loyalty. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's just terrible! The interface is so **confusing** and it's incredibly **hard to use**. I read the **user manual** twice and it's useless. Honestly, I **expected more** from VeloFit. I want my money back. If you can't do that, get me your manager.
I understand your frustration completely, Mark, and there's no need to speak to a manager. I can handle this for you. One moment while I review our policy for your purchase date.

Okay, I've just checked. It looks like your VeloBand Pulse was delivered 21 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window. I can process this return for you immediately.
Wait, really? You're just going to take it back? No fight?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return and a pre-paid shipping label has been sent to your email. And since you're a VIP member and had such a frustrating experience, I've also gone ahead and added a $50 store credit to your account as an apology from us at VeloFit.
Oh. A $50 credit? Well... okay. That's... actually very helpful. So the label is in my email right now?
Yes, it should be there waiting for you. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse scans it in, your full refund will be processed.
Alright. That's good service. Thank you, Sarah.
You're very welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
